locale.label: Language
locale.formatNote: Amounts and dates follow this language's conventions.

defaults.explanation: Applied to loans you add from now on. Existing loans keep their own settings.

data.storedLocally: Your loans are stored in this browser and never sent anywhere.
data.onlyRequest: The app makes one kind of outbound request: fetching published interest rates. It carries nothing about you.
data.exportHelp: Downloads a file with your loans, scenarios and settings.
data.importHelp: Choose a file you exported earlier.
data.importMergeHelp: Keeps your existing loans. Loans in the file replace ones with the same identity.
data.importReplaceHelp: Deletes everything currently stored first. Cannot be undone.
data.clearHelp: Removes every loan, scenario and setting from this browser.
data.clearConfirm: Delete everything? Export a backup first if you might want it back.

about.disclaimer: LoanLens is not financial advice and is not affiliated with the ECB. Check anything that matters against your lender's own figures.
about.rateSource: Interest rates come from the ECB Data Portal, provided to the ECB by Refinitiv.
